title: How can Peter say the Spirit spoke if the words are the Savior's?
english: How then can Peter say, “It was necessary for Scripture to be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit foretold through the mouth of David” (Acts 1:16), if the Savior is the one saying these things? Perhaps what we are taught here is of such a kind.

orientation: Origen is raising the objection that the Psalm's words seem to be spoken by the Savior, yet Peter attributes them to the Holy Spirit, and he is about to introduce the principle that resolves this.

title: The Holy Spirit personifies in the prophets
english: The Holy Spirit personifies in the prophets. When the Spirit personifies God, God is not the one speaking; the Holy Spirit speaks from the person of God. When the Spirit personifies Christ, Christ is not the one speaking; the Holy Spirit speaks from the person of Christ.

orientation: Origen is answering the objection about who speaks in the Psalm by explaining how the Holy Spirit speaks through the prophets.

title: The Holy Spirit personifies all persons
english: So too, even if the Spirit personifies the prophet, or that people, or this people, or whatever at all it personifies, it is the Holy Spirit who personifies all things.
